assign.request: Improve the blog and the magazine: look, brainstorm, build. Read + drive /blog/ and /imagine/mag/ at all widths, rank 8-12 improvements each, build the top 2-3 that are S/M. Candidates: RSS/Atom feed from posts.js via meta.mjs, reading time on cards + posts, a next-post flow so the reading path never dead-ends, date polish; mag: circular self-navigation, cover restraint-check, second lead treatment. Manifest stays the single source; every url cold-loadable; re-stamp shells if the manifest gains fields.

assign.now: ranked the brainstorm; building feed + next-post + reading time

log.msg: LOOK done. /blog/ and /imagine/mag/ driven headless at 400/1920/3440, 8 urls each width: zero console errors, no layout breaks. meta.mjs baseline 10/10 ok.

BLOG, ranked. 1 RSS/Atom feed - the classic missing feature, and nothing on the site is subscribable (S/M, BUILD). 2 next-post flow - a post ends at a rail of back-links, the reading path dead-ends (S, BUILD). 3 reading time on card+hero+byline, counted from the md at stamp time (M, BUILD). 4 section label on a front card - three sections mix in the wall and a card only says a date. 5 prev/next INSIDE a multi-part post - the rail lists parts, the prose ends cold. 6 an updated: field - a manifest date is publication only. 7 the 3440 lead: 7.5cqw of a narrow track makes the widest screen feel the smallest, lower-left fold empty. 8 sitemap.xml from the same manifest, same argument as the feed. 9 a section shell borrows the newest post picture - a section of unpictured posts ships a text card. 10 card desc clamps identically at 1920 and 3440. 11 a topic axis beyond the three sections - the chips are section counts. 12 og:image:alt defaults nobody reads.

MAG, ranked. 1 the next-hop is one-way - no previous, so an article opened from the contents cannot walk back in reading order (S). 2 the article head never says where you are in the issue - no is computed and drawn only on the contents entry (S, BUILD). 3 a read entry on the contents looks like an unread one. 4 no length per entry. 5 the cover has no motion at all, so the restraint-check has nothing to restrain - Open the issue is a static word. 6 a second lead treatment on the contents. 7 By the Numbers rows are hand-stamped measurements nothing re-measures. 8 the bleed figures are decorative divs with no accessible name. 9 the colophon points at /imagine/mag/readme/ - verify. 10 issue 02 would need a second issue.json and there is no seam for it yet.

CUT for this pass: everything below rank 3 on each list. The blog three are built because each removes a MISSING capability (subscribe, continue reading, how long is this) rather than restyling one that works.

BUILT 1/3 - the Atom feed. meta.mjs now writes /blog/feed.xml from posts.js, and every stamped shell carries the autodiscovery link. Atom over RSS 2.0 for one reason: RFC 3339 is the manifest date plus a constant, while RFC 822 needs new Date(post.date) - the exact call posts.js refuses because a bare YYYY-MM-DD is UTC midnight and prints a day early in America. Validated with Chromium DOMParser plus Atom conformance logic: 6 entries, feed id/title/updated, rel=self type application/atom+xml, an author, and every entry with id, absolute link, RFC3339 published+updated, category and a non-empty summary. Zero problems. Served 200 as application/xml (express mime for .xml; readers sniff the root element, and the rel=self inside the feed is where it states its own type).

BUILT 2/3 - reading time. meta.mjs counts each post md and writes words.js (generated, committed); posts.js turns a count into minutes at 220 wpm - the counts are facts, the rate is the one judgement. Shown on the card meta line, the hero eyebrow and the post byline. Accuracy vs a headless innerText count of .blog-prose: hello-lew42 0.4%, layout-generators -0.1%, panel-playground 0.6%, dashboard 0.5%, claude-tooling 0.5%, how-this-blog-works -5.6%. All inside 10%.

TWO TRAPS the word count found, both silent. (1) hello-lew42 counted ZERO - its parts: were declared in its own page.js, which node cannot import (page.js imports /app.js, a browser url), so md_files() looked for a post.md that never existed. Nothing threw; the card just stopped saying how long the post was. Parts moved to the manifest, hello-lew42/page.js is now genuinely two lines, and a zero count now prints a warning. (2) an images alt is not read - counting ![alt](x.png) like a link put 113 words of alt into panel-playground and stamped it 21% over. Dropped; the post went 658 -> 548 words, 3 min -> 2 min.

BUILT 3/3 - the reading path. Post.next_up() puts the next PART, else the next POST, else the front at the bottom of every posts prose. Clicked headless, never typed: hello-lew42 -> pages -> open -> how-this-blog-works -> reading-page -> layout-generators -> panel-playground -> dashboard -> claude-tooling -> /blog/. Eleven hops, all 6 posts and all 5 parts, ending at the archive. Two forced shapes: the box is created in render() and MOVED to the end in after_prose() (read() returns a promise for a single-part post and append_promise lands it last, so anything built synchronously after it sits ABOVE the prose), and it rebuilds on every after_prose() because parts fire that on activate and deactivate without re-running content().

MAG - verified, then extended. The next-hop circle already closed: clicked all six articles headless and the sixth returned to /imagine/mag/, no console errors. Extension is rank 2 on the mag list: an article head now says 03 / 06 beside its section - the number existed but was drawn only on the contents entry, so a reader who opened one from the row could not tell whether three more were coming or thirty. Counted from the same insertion-ordered Map next() walks, so a seventh article renumbers the issue and nothing says six out loud.

VERIFY. meta.mjs 12/12 ok (10 shells + feed.xml + words.js), exit 0. 12 urls x 400/1920/3440 = 36 loads: zero console errors, zero horizontal overflow. Homepage still lists 4 posts off the same manifest, clean. Private server on 8097 only, torn down; port 80 never touched.

assign.outcome:
**Three things the blog could not do before, and one the magazine could not say.**

A reader can now **subscribe**, see **how long a post is** before opening it, and **keep reading** at the bottom of every one. All three are derived from the manifest — nothing was typed twice.

![The front: reading times on every card, the feed in the rail](front.png)

- [**/blog/feed.xml**](/blog/feed.xml) — Atom 1.0, generated by `meta.mjs` from `posts.js`. Every stamped shell carries the autodiscovery `<link>`, so a *subscribe* button lights up on a **post**, not only on the front. Validated with a real XML parser plus Atom conformance logic: **zero problems**. Atom over RSS 2.0 because RFC 3339 is the manifest's own date plus a constant, while RFC 822 needs the `new Date(post.date)` that `posts.js` refuses.
- **Reading time** on every card, hero and byline — counted from each post's `.md` at stamp time into a generated `words.js`; `posts.js` turns a count into minutes at 220 wpm. Checked against a headless `innerText` count of the rendered prose: **five of six inside 0.6%**, worst −5.6%.
- **The reading path never dead-ends.** [`Post.next_up()`](/blog/ai/dashboard/) offers the next *part*, else the next *post*, else the front. Clicked headless, never typed — **11 hops, all 6 posts and all 5 parts**, ending at the archive.

![Next in this post, and next post](next-part.png)

- **Magazine** — the next-hop circle was verified rather than assumed: all six articles clicked through, the sixth returning to the cover, no console errors. Extended with the one thing an article never said: **`03 / 06`** beside its section, counted from the running order itself.

![An article that says where it is in the issue](mag-place.png)

**Two silent bugs the word count flushed out.** `hello-lew42` counted **zero** — its `parts:` lived in its own `page.js`, which node cannot import, so the generator looked for a `post.md` that never existed. Nothing threw. Parts moved to the manifest, and a zero now reports itself. And an **image's `alt` is not read**: counting it as prose stamped `panel-playground` **21% over** its real length.

**Docs** — [The feed, and how long a post is](/blog/doc/feed/) · [readme](/blog/readme.md) · [file structure](/blog/doc/structure/) · [mag readme](/imagine/mag/readme/)

**Verified** — `meta.mjs` **12/12 ok** (10 shells + `feed.xml` + `words.js`), exit 0 · 12 urls × 400/1920/3440 = **36 loads, zero console errors, zero horizontal overflow** · feed served 200 · homepage still lists 4 posts off the same manifest · private server on 8097 only, torn down.

**Left, ranked.** Blog: a section label on a front card (three sections mix in the wall and a card only says a date) · prev/next *inside* a multi-part post · an `updated:` field, since a manifest date is publication only · the 3440 lead, sized at 7.5cqw of a narrow track so the widest screen feels the smallest · `sitemap.xml` from the same generator. Mag: no *previous* hop · a read contents entry looks unread · no length per entry · the cover has no motion, so the restraint-check had nothing to restrain · `By the Numbers` rows are hand-stamped measurements nothing re-measures.
